note: A baseline for the pipeline, not for the engine. Three seeds, eight null windows per node and three anomalies are too few to conclude anything about the engine, and the tree is the demo tree, not a canonical evaluation tree. Do not cite these numbers as findings. It replaces the 2026-11-19 baseline after the runner moved to the generator's stated contract (fake_companies b51d70e); the three anomalies are pinned with --singles to the ones that baseline ran, so the two pair world for world. Q5 attribution was added on 2026-11-21 by rerunning the nine single worlds only (calibration rows and fits reused). The engine commit's +dirty is the then-uncommitted runner fix that became 3656f58, and docs; breakdown/ was clean, as the engine key records.
